property.name: endnoteRangeStartIndex
property.shortdesc: Starting Index of the endnote range object.

property.name: endnoteRangeEndIndex
property.shortdesc: Ending Index of the endnote range object.

property.name: id
property.shortdesc: The unique ID of the EndnoteRange.

property.name: isValid
property.shortdesc: Returns true if the object specifier resolves to valid objects.

property.name: parent
property.shortdesc: The parent of the EndnoteRange (a Text, InsertionPoint, TextStyleRange, Paragraph, TextColumn, Line, Word, Character, Story or XmlStory).

property.name: index
property.shortdesc: The index of the EndnoteRange within its containing object.

property.name: sourceEndnote
property.shortdesc: The endnote reference corresponding to the endnote text range.

property.name: endnoteRangeContent
property.shortdesc: EndnoteRange Contents, It will skip the endnote number while setting/replacing the content into endnote range. Can return: String, SpecialCharacters enumerator or Array of Strings or SpecialCharacters enumerators. Can also accept: NothingEnum enumerator or Array of Strings, SpecialCharacters enumerators or NothingEnum enumerators.

property.name: label
property.shortdesc: A property that can be set to any string.

property.name: name
property.shortdesc: The name of the EndnoteRange; this is an alias to the EndnoteRange's label property.

property.name: properties
property.shortdesc: A property that allows setting of several properties at the same time.

method.name: deleteEndnoteRange
method.shortdesc: Deletes the endnote range and the associated endnote anchor.

method.name: insertLabel
method.shortdesc: Sets the label to the value associated with the specified key.

method.name: extractLabel
method.shortdesc: Gets the label value associated with the specified key.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the EndnoteRange.

method.name: getElements
method.shortdesc: Resolves the object specifier, creating an array of object references.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The registered event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.
